content.text:
All requisition lines are ordered and issued.

## Issued purchase orders — Alder West (request ALDER-WEST)

| PO | Vendor | Item | Qty | Unit | Amount | Commitment ref | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ALDER-WEST-PO-1 | Alder-Storage | Alder-shelf (storage shelf) | 3 | $140.00 | $420.00 | ALDER-WEST-TX-1 | Issued |
| ALDER-WEST-PO-2 | Alder-Equipment | Alder-cart (equipment cart) | 4 | $160.00 | $640.00 | ALDER-WEST-TX-2 | Issued |

**Total committed: $1,060.00 (106,000 cents)**

## Reconciliation

- **Requisition coverage:** both lines ordered in full, correct vendors and quantities (3 shelves, 4 carts). No substitutions or partial quantities.
- **Alder-Equipment quote:** $160.00/unit, tax and delivery included → 4 × $160.00 = $640.00. Matches PO-2 exactly.
- **Alder-Storage quote:** the document `Alder-Storage-quote.json` could **not** be downloaded from the document service — repeated attempts returned `503 Document download unavailable` (the name exists, so it is not a naming error; other documents, including the Equipment quote, downloaded fine). The $140.00/unit price is the unit rate the order system applied when the draft was priced (3 × $140.00 = $420.00). **This line should be re-verified against the quote when the document service is available**, since I could not confirm tax/delivery inclusion directly.
- **Budget check — action needed:** the cost centre `Alder West` has a purchasing budget of **$850.00** for period 2026-10. Committed spend is **$1,060.00**, i.e. **$210.00 (24.7%) over budget**. The approval step did not block either order and both issued successfully, so this overage is now recorded as a commitment. Options: obtain a budget increase/supplemental allocation for the period, or cancel/reduce a line (e.g. drop one cart to come in at $900.00, still over; drop two carts → $740.00, within budget). Note that issued orders can no longer be cancelled through the workstation's cancel function (draft/approved only), so any correction needs to go through budget adjustment or a return/credit process.
- **Divergence check:** no duplicate orders were created; only PO-1 and PO-2 exist, both issued, with exactly one commitment each.
